prompt_en:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: original single-canvas subculture narrative illustration
Primary request: Depict one adult night mender completing the final handoff before closing inside a worn memory-repair workshop. First glance: one adult night mender reaches across the counter with a repaired, heavily worn coat while one anonymous recipient hand enters the closing doorway, frozen a finger-width before contact. At the decisive instant, the one adult mender extends the repaired coat while the recipient's cropped hand stops a finger-width short of contact. The visible actor is the adult night mender. The directed action is extending the repaired coat across the counter. The visible target is the repaired coat held toward the approaching recipient hand. The visible consequence is that the taut thread pulls the last loose cuff seam shut while the untouched closing bell already swings. Keep the adult mender's extending hand, the repaired coat cuff, the approaching recipient hand, and the single crimson thread as the primary high-contrast diagonal; keep the isolated tilted bell as the only separated secondary discovery.
Second look: the untouched closing bell is already swinging while the repaired coat and recipient hand remain separated. Use one large isolated brass closing bell already leaning on a taut crimson thread in the clear black doorway above the untouched recipient hand. The isolated brass closing bell leans and its displaced clapper swings while the repaired coat and recipient hand remain separated. Keep its rigid ceiling chain vertical while the bell body tilts about thirty degrees and its clapper displaces to the opposite side; no hand touches the bell. One taut crimson thread runs from the repaired cuff to the displaced clapper, making the impossible early motion physically traceable. Use the plain seamless dark receiving slab below the doorway as a separate secondary clue. Rain beads stop around one broad irregular dry coat-length patch that crosses the continuous grain of the plain dark receiving slab. No rug, mat, border, weave, tile, inlay, printed ornament, or regular rectangular color block; the dry boundary must be soft, uneven, and diagonal across uninterrupted stone grain. Matching crescent abrasions on the coat cuff, the mender's leather thimble, the counter edge, and a repaired stool leg show one long working history. Beyond the bell and slab, the black doorway withholds the recipient and leaves the next destination recoverable only from the material trail.
The familiar anchor is one adult night mender completing the final handoff before closing. The governing changed rule is that memory reaches the workshop's closing mechanisms one beat before the repaired object crosses the doorway. Use one-beat-ahead closing bell as the sole repeatable signature. A taut crimson fiber wraps the mender's needle fingers and enters the coat cuff. The same crimson thread loosens into translucent memory loops inside one clear glass bobbin. The same thread leaves the repaired cuff, becomes taut in open air, and pulls the closing bell clapper before the handoff. Repeat only one motif family—the single crimson memory thread—through the mender's fingers, glass bobbin, repaired cuff, and bell clapper, changing its physical state at each transfer.
Use firm dark ink edges only around the mender's extending hand, the recipient's cropped hand, the coat cuff, the needle, the crimson thread, and the bell body with its displaced clapper; reduce tools to softer lines and let peripheral shelves break into dry, unfinished strokes. Let rear shelves, ceiling corners, and the far floor dissolve into quiet paper grain with incomplete marks. Leave the black doorway around the isolated bell and the outer shelves as silent negative space, hiding the recipient while protecting the bell silhouette. Stage the handoff as large simple masses within the central canvas so it reads at 320 pixels; keep the bell body and displaced clapper unmistakable at that scale, and keep the crimson route continuous from hand through garment to bell. Preserve one decisive instant, one fully visible adult actor, and no duplicated figure or timeline echo. No readable text, captions, labels, logos, named style, protected design, or franchise element.
negative_en: named artist or studio imitation, protected character or franchise copy, franchise logo, readable generated title text, random symbol stack, universal color or shape stereotype, aspect-ratio-only composition, unclear actor-action-target relation, equal-detail clutter, static character lineup, lore exposition text
